```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(data.table)
```

```{r}
dnds_table <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/dnds_thaliana/Athaliana_terminal_dN_dS_omega_with_positions.tsv", header=T)
# Read centromeres
centromeres <- read.csv2('/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/01_data/tair10/centr_boundaries_wlodzimierz2023.txt',header=T, sep="\t")
```
## Make figure per window 
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# Bin per-gene omega into 300 kb windows
dnds_windowed <- dnds_table %>%
  filter(omega <= 1) %>%                          # remove outliers
  mutate(window_start = floor(start / 3e5) * 3e5,
         window_end   = window_start + 3e5) %>%
  group_by(chromosome, window_start, window_end) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(avg_omega = mean(omega, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

#  Rename centromere column to match dnds_windowed
centromeres_renamed <- centromeres %>%
  dplyr::rename(chromosome = chrom)

# Step 3: Join centromeres, mask centromeric windows, compute ribbon 
dnds_all <- dnds_windowed %>%
  left_join(centromeres_renamed %>% dplyr::select(chromosome, centr_start = start, centr_stop = stop),
            by = "chromosome") %>%
  mutate(avg_omega = ifelse(window_start <= centr_stop &
                            window_end   >= centr_start,
                            NA, avg_omega)) %>%       # mask exactly the centromere
  group_by(chromosome) %>%
  mutate(
    med_omega = median(avg_omega, na.rm = TRUE),
    above     = ifelse(avg_omega >= med_omega, avg_omega, med_omega),
    region    = case_when(
      window_end   < centr_start ~ "left",            # strictly left of centromere
      window_start > centr_stop  ~ "right",           # strictly right of centromere
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Plot
p <- ggplot(dnds_all, aes(x = window_start / 1e6, y = avg_omega)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = med_omega, ymax = above),
              fill = "#053061", alpha = 0.3, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_smooth(data = dnds_all %>% filter(region == "left"),
              method = "loess", span = 0.2, color = "#053061", se = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_smooth(data = dnds_all %>% filter(region == "right"),
              method = "loess", span = 0.2, color = "#053061", se = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_point(size = 0.8, color = "#053061", alpha = 0.5, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = med_omega), linetype = "dashed",
             color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_rect(data = centromeres_renamed,
            aes(xmin = (start ) / 1e6,
                xmax = (stop  ) / 1e6,
                ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = "darkgrey", alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_y_continuous() +
  facet_wrap(~ chromosome, scales = "free_x", nrow = 1) +
  labs(x = "Position (Mb)", y = expression(dN/dS)) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 16) +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank())

p

ggsave("dnds_all_chromosomes.png",
       plot = p,
       width = 300, height = 100, units = "mm", dpi = 600,
       bg = "white")
```

```{r}
# Match pi plot 
dnds_all <- dnds_windowed %>%
  left_join(centromeres_renamed %>% select(chromosome, centr_start = start, centr_stop = stop),
            by = "chromosome") %>%
  mutate(avg_omega = ifelse(window_start <= centr_stop  + 250000 &
                            window_end   >= centr_start - 250000,
                            NA, avg_omega)) %>%
  group_by(chromosome) %>%
  mutate(
    med_omega = median(avg_omega, na.rm = TRUE),
    above     = ifelse(avg_omega >= med_omega, avg_omega, med_omega),
    region    = case_when(
      window_end   < centr_start - 250000 ~ "left",
      window_start > centr_stop  + 250000 ~ "right",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

#Plot
p <- ggplot(dnds_all, aes(x = window_start / 1e6, y = avg_omega)) +
  geom_smooth(data = dnds_all %>% filter(region == "left"),
              method = "loess", span = 0.2, color = "#f4a582", se = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_smooth(data = dnds_all %>% filter(region == "right"),
              method = "loess", span = 0.2, color = "#f4a582", se = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_point(size = 0.8, na.rm = TRUE, color = "#f4a582", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = med_omega), linetype = "dashed",
             color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_rect(data = centromeres_renamed,
            aes(xmin = (start - 250000) / 1e6,
                xmax = (stop  + 250000) / 1e6,
                ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = "darkgrey", alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_y_continuous() +
  facet_wrap(~ chromosome, scales = "free_x", nrow = 1) +
  labs(x = "Position (Mb)", y = expression(dN/dS)) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 16) +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank())

p
```
